notes_check.consequence: The gap record scored the ask against the question bank only, so the examiner-organised Notes were invisible to it. The Notes support the ask rather than dissolving it, and a promotion of that unit creates a card rather than enriching one.

candidate_failure_test.question: Studying the current 720-question QB plus the Oral Notes, can a candidate give a coherent CE response to 'your ship has collided, what do you do now'?
candidate_failure_test.reason: The constituent material exists but is distributed across a hull-damage-and-pollution card, a generic flag-State casualty card, a war-zone fatality investigation card, an emergency-contacts card and two Notes pages. Nothing in the corpus routes the word collision to any of them; searching collision returns collision avoidance, the collision bulkhead and the liability clauses. No card assembles the sequence, and the ask is a single flowing examiner chain.

corpus_sweep.bulkhead_versus_response: A SOLAS II-1 Reg. 12 collision bulkhead answer is a design requirement - position from the forward perpendicular, height to the bulkhead deck, permitted openings. It was not treated as casualty-response coverage, and no genuine emergency-response card was found to already own the post-collision scenario.

last_resort_test.B_reason: The nearest card, QB4_G#q7, is stemmed to hull damage or oil pollution and is built as a two-branch structure. Absorbing this ask would add collision-specific immediate action, the statutory casualty reporting chain and the full submitted record set - four substantive limbs, not one - and would leave the stem inaccurate and the topic undiscoverable from the word collision.

target_selection_reason: QB4_G already holds the CE operational casualty neighbourhood - Q7 the hull damage and pollution response, Q6 the casualty investigation and report contents, Q10 informing authorities after a rescue. A candidate looking for post-collision action looks where the CE emergency procedures live, and placing the card beside Q7 and Q6 makes the cross-links adjacent rather than remote. QB9_H was rejected as the home because it is the legal, conventions and liability file; the ask is an operational sequence with a reporting tail, and QB9_H#q2 is cross-linked from the new card instead.

new_card.question_text: Your ship has been in a collision with another vessel - as CE what will you check, how is the reporting done, and what documents and records must be preserved and submitted?

authority_scope.instrument: Casualty Investigation Code, Res. MSC.255(84), mandatory via SOLAS XI-1/6
authority_scope.basis: already carried and verified in the corpus at QB9_H#q2
verified against the IMO resolution text - fixed and float-free capsules at least 48 hours, long-term recording medium at least 30 days, for VDRs installed on or after 1 July 2014
verified - guidelines on VDR ownership and recovery; the owner owns the VDR and its information and is responsible for timely preservation and collection after a casualty
emergency preparedness, and reports and analysis of accidents
damage control information; already carried and verified at QB1_supplementary#q16
verified - duty to render assistance to the other vessel and to exchange the ship's name, port of registry and ports of departure and destination

numbers_deliberately_omitted: Note of Protest noting deadline - stated as after arrival rather than with an hour figure, because the period is jurisdiction and practice dependent
VDR retention under the superseded A.861(20) standard - not introduced, to avoid presenting two conflicting figures to a candidate

corpus_debt_observed.issue: A Simon tip instructs the candidate to answer VDR retention as 48 hours primary loop, 12 hours protected capsule, 30 days long-term medium. Under Res. MSC.333(90) the protected fixed and float-free capsules retain at least 48 hours; the 12-hour figure belongs to the superseded A.861(20) standard. The stated mapping would be marked wrong.
corpus_debt_observed.reason: out of scope for this bounded exception session

examiner_relationship_delta.reason: The source evidence proves the ask but the exception review carries no explicit examiner relationship authorisation, so no relation was released. The examiner snapshot was regenerated only because its canonical_questions metadata moved from 720 to 721.

pre_existing_card_digests.note: sha256 of each pre-existing q-card in the destination file, taken by balanced div extraction before the new card was inserted and re-verified after. EOL normalised to LF for comparison. Any drift means the insertion damaged a card that was already published.
